work_unit: Seven-character signup password policy and confirmation validation

dispatch.scope: Authoritative password policy and registration regression tests
dispatch.outcome: accepted after coordinator inspection and focused verification

dispatch.scope: Browser confirmation and matching client-side constraints

implementation.browser: Signup requires a 7-256 character password, marks a nonmatching confirmation invalid, and shows a clear mismatch error on submission.
implementation.server: Registration accepts passwords from 7 through 256 characters and keeps the generic failure response for invalid values. The existing Argon2 hashing, no-plaintext storage, and login behavior remain unchanged.

verification.backend: Five registration tests passed, including seven-character acceptance, six-character rejection, 256-character acceptance, 257-character rejection, hash behavior, Ruff, and mypy.
verification.frontend: TypeScript, scoped ESLint, Prettier, and patch checks passed.
verification.runtime: The local API was restarted and its health endpoint returned status ok.
